title: WALK IN FAITH
GOD PROVIDES
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: peaceful river flowing through green hills
golden hour sunlight over quiet hills
sunlit ancient stone table in forest
open door light streaming through nature
vast peaceful landscape under blue sky

scenes.a: As you calculate that looming financial deficit with a heavy heart, listen to God.
Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
Lord, we lean upon Your unfailing promise today when our own strength fails us.
Delight thyself also in the LORD: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
Father, we place every anxious burden and every uncertain step directly into Your hands.
Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
scenes.sub: HE SHALL BRING IT TO PASS

scenes.a: Grant us quiet confidence in Your provision this day, in Jesus name, amen.
